about_the_game:
[IN DEVELOPMENT]

Single Player story mode yet to come, the demo only contains a 2-4 player COUCH CO-OP party mode, described below!

   KAERI GAMES presents OKO's QUEST, an upcoming local multiplayer action RPG that will soon offer both a 1-4 player couch multiplayer story mode and party mode.

    The Great Witch Oko has sent out a scroll, containing a quest, to herself from across various dimensions. Once opened the scroll teleports the reader to the Great Witch's dimension. Unfortunately, the Great Witch has horrible handwriting, so it's up to Okos to figure out, what is Oko's Quest?

   Oko's Quest Party Mode is a 2-4 player local multiplayer battle that features many aspects from the story mode! Do you like bite sized RPG game experiences? Well then grab your friends, it's Party Mode~!

From the luck based, damage dealing Playing Cards to the back-stabbing ghost knife. Enhance your build with items that augment character abilities and create unique play styles.

Players can visit shops, find chests, go fishing, and battle both monsters and each other! Gather gold, EXP, and items before the timer runs out. A final event will then put your vitality, strength, speed, and luck to the test to determine the winner!

Random events may occur on the island and powerful bosses await players that dare challenge them.

Will your build be enough to win? Go find out!!

The full release of Oko's Quest will include:

-completed party mode

-a single/ co-op story

-at least 4 playable Okos

-unlock-able characters from the story mode

-accessibility options

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core™ Duo or faster
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ / DirectX 11+
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Oko's Quest is an upcoming local multiplayer action RPG featuring both a co-op story and party mode. Set in a fantasy world, different Okos across dimensions have been involuntarily summoned to a mysterious island. Why were they summoned and how will they return home?
